Winsorise IPTW weights within the arm or arms that are reweighted

Source: R/utils.R
dot-trim_weights.Rd

For the ATT, the treated arm is the reference and keeps weights of exactly 1, so only the control weights are winsorised, at the (trim, 1 - trim) quantiles of the control weights. The ATC is the mirror image. For the ATE both arms are reweighted and neither is a reference, so the weights are winsorised at quantiles of all weights pooled across both arms, as Lee, Lessler and Stuart (2011) do.

Usage

.trim_weights(w, trt, estimand, trim)

Arguments

w

Numeric weight vector; NA marks an excluded patient.

trt

Integer 0/1 treatment indicator, the same length as w.

estimand

One of "ATE", "ATT", "ATC".

trim

A number in (0, 0.5).

Value

w, winsorised.
